div.p: 184b6 rgya gar gyi mkhan po Abhayavajra dang | bod kyi lotsāba sBal rdo rje rgyal pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o || rgya gar skad du | Āryamañjuśrīnāmasaṃgītitīkā 184b7 Vimalaprabhā | bod skad du | 'Phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba | 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo || Verses of praise stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can || srid gsum skye dang zad pa 185a1 med || shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i lus || dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal ||1||
(cf. VP: namaḥ śrīkālacakrāya śūnyatākaruṇātmane | tribhavotpattikṣayābhāvajñānajñeyaikamurttaye ||)
We bow to the Ādibuddha whose body is the unity of knowledge and the objects of knowledge, the triple world free from arising and ceasing, with the nature of emptiness and compassion.

rnam pa dang bcas rnam pa med pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma des rab tu 'khyud | dgod pa la sogs sgeg dang 'jigs pa'i 'dod pa'i bde ba rnam par 185a2 spangs pa'i mi 'gyur bde || sku gsum dang ldan dus gsum yang dag mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rab tu skyed byed pa || thams cad mkhyen pa dang po mchog gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal ||2||

(cf. VP: sākārā ca (pi) nirākṛtir bhagavatī prajñā tayāliṅgita utpādavyavarjito ’kṣarasukho hāsyādisaukhyojjhitaḥ | buddhānāṃ janakas trikāyasahitas traikālyasaṃvedakaḥ sarvajñaḥ paramādibuddhabhagavān vande tam evādvayam ||)

We bow to the Bhagavat non-dual by nature, the supreme Ādibuddha, omniscient, the father of Buddhas, he perfectly knows the tree times and is endowed with the three bodies, his bliss is unchangeable, he is totally free from worldly pleasure, and of laughter and so forth, from beautify and fear, he is embraced by blessed lady prajna who, although free from aspects, appears with aspects. stong nyid ye shes yang dag pa ||
rnam 185a3 dag ye shes mi g.yo ba || mtshan med ye shes yang dag cing || chos kyi bdag nyid gnyis med sems ||3||
(cf. VP: śūnyatājñānasaṃśuddhaṃ viśuddhajñānam akṣaram | animittajñānasaṃśuddhaṃ dharmātmā(ma)cittam advayam ||)

To him, who is the non-dual mind the nature of which is the dharma, perfectly pure awareness without characteristics, unmoving purified awareness which is perfectly purified by emptiness and awareness (awareness about/of emptiness).We bow to the Adibuddha whose body is the unity of knowledge and the objects of knowledge, the triple world free from arising and ceasing, with the nature of emptiness and compassion.
smon pa'i ye shes dag pa yi || gsung gi sngags ni mi zad dbyangs || de bzhin mngon par 'du mi byed || ye shes dag phyir rnyog pa med ||4||
(cf. VP: vāgpraṇihitajñānaśuddho mantro ’kṣayo dhvaniḥ | evam anabhisaṃskārajñānaśuddho hy anāvilaḥ ||)
[shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor ||] sku yi rnam pas 185a4 rdzu 'phrul gshegs || rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che || byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs ||5||
(cf. VP: prajñōpāyātmake yogaḥ saṃsthānakāya ṛddhigaḥ | vajrasattvo mahāsattvo bodhisattvas tathāgatataiḥ (taḥ) ||)
dam tshig sems dpas gsungs pa gang || dngos dang dngos med zad pa'i bdag || thog ma tha ma med zhi ba || byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo ||6|| 185a5
(cf. VP: uktaḥ samyasattvo yo bhāvābhavakṣayo vibhuḥ | anādinidhanaḥ śānto bodhisattvaṃ praṇamya tam ||)
sprul pa po yi sku gsung thugs || ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba rdzogs || longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs || ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba sdom ||7||
(cf. VP: nirmānakāyavākcittajñānaikaṃ yogasaṃvaram | sambhogakāyavākcittajñānaikaṃ yogasaṃvaram ||)
dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs || ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba sdom || lhan cig skyes 185a6 pa'i sku gsung thugs || ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba sdom ||8||
(cf. VP: śrīdharmakāyavākcittajñānaikaṃ yogasaṃvaram | sahajakāyavākcittajñānaikaṃ yogasaṃvaram ||)
sad pa'i rmi lam gnyid stug dang || bzhi pa dbang po gnyis skyes bde || ye shes thugs gsung sku yi ni || gnas bzhi rnams su mi gnas te ||9||
(cf. VP: jāgratsvapnasusu(ṣu)ptaṃ na turya dvīndriyajaṃ sukham | na jñānacittavākkāyaḥ catu(ḥ)sthāneṣu saṃsthitam ||)
las kyi phyag rgya rnam par spangs || [ye shes phyag rgya rnam par spangs ||] phyag 185a7 rgya chen po las byung ba || lhan skyes gzhan dang lhan cig min ||10||
(cf. VP: karmamudrāparityaktaṃ jñānamudrāvivarjitam | mahāmudrāsamutpannaṃ sahajaṃ nānyayā saha ||)
rnam rtog bsgom pa las 'das pa || phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde || gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa yi || rtog pa brjod pa rnam par spangs ||11||
(cf. VP: vikalpabhāvanātītaṃ mahāmudrākṣaraṃ sukham | grāhyagrāhakasaṃsthānakalpajalpavivarjitam ||)
dri za'i grong khyer rnam pa dang || phra rnams kyi ni rang bzhin du || 185b1 thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin sbyor || evaṁ yi ge la phyag 'tshal ||12|
| (cf. VP: gandharvanagarākāraṃ partisenāsvarūpakam | prajñopāyātmakaṃ yogaṃ evaṃkāraṃ praṇamya tam ||)

de bzhin gang zhig rdo rje rnal 'byor bde gshegs dpag tu med pa dang ni bstan pa de bzhin 'di || byang chub sems dpa' mchog gi rdo rje 'chang bas gsang sngags ma lus pa rnams 185b2 rig pas yang dag bsdus || blun po bdag gis rnal 'byor mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba dus 'khor mtshan brjod gnyis don bshad par 'dod || nam mkha' la ni mgyogs par 'gro ba'i nam mkha'i bdag po 'gro zhes ci'i phyir gzhan dag la 185b3 mi 'gro ||13||

(cf. VP: evaṃ yo vajrayogo ’parimitasugataiḥ sevito deśitaś ca saṅgīto bodhisattvair varakuliśadharair mantravidbhiḥ samastaiḥ | taṃ yogaṃ vaktukāmo ’kṣaraparamasukhaṃ kālacakre jaḍo ’ham ākāśe śīghragāmī vrajati khagapatiḥ kiṃ na yātynyapakṣī ||)

ston pa rang gi lung bstan gang zhig rgyal ba'i bdag po bde ster rdo rje theg pa ma lus pa'i || sdud par byed pa mchog gi rdo rje 'dzin par rgya cher 'grel byed bdag 'dra'i byang chub sems dpa' ste || de phyir sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha dang klu dang mi 185b4 rnams kun ni smin par bya ba'i don du gsungs || gang dag mngon shes lnga med de ni brdzun pa'i tshig gis bdag ni rgyal ba'i dbang po yin zhes smra ||14||

(cf. VP: śāstrāsvaṃ (śāstraivaṃT rejects this em) vyākṛtā ye jinapatisukhade vajrayāne samastāḥ ṭīkā saṅgītikārā varakuliśadharā mādṛśā bodhisattvāḥ | te ’smin buddhānubhāvaṃ surabhujaganṛṇāṃ pācanārthaṃ bruvanti pañcābhijñā na yeṣām anṛtam iti jinendrā vayaṃ te bruvanti ||)

sna tshogs klu yis ma 'ongs dus su rtag tu rtog ge la sogs bstan bcos kyis dregs pa'i || sangs 185b5 rgyas pa rnams gzhan gyi rtog ge'i stobs kyi dbang gis log par yang ni smra ba 'byung || rtog ge'i dregs pa'i tshul gang gis ni rgan pa'i yul gang ston par byed || blo ngan de dag kho na'i nyes pa 'joms pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bdag gis bri bar bya ||15|| 185b6

(cf. VP: nānābuddhir anāgate ’dhvani sadā tarkādiśāstrārpitā bauddhānāṃ tarkasaṅgam avaśān mithyā bhaviṣyaty api | tarkād arpitapā(yā) tayeṣṭaviṣaye ye mārgasandeśakāḥ teṣām eva kubuddhidoṣamathanī ṭīkā mayā likhyate ||)
mchog tu mi 'gyur bzhi pa dang || de bzhin shes rab ye shes gang || sangs rgyas de yang de bzhin 'dir || phyag rgya chen po rgyal bas gsungs ||16||
(cf. VP:. paramākṣaraṃ caturtha prajñājñānaṃ tad eva buddhānām | yattat punas tatheyaṃ svamahāmudrā jinenoktā ||)
dpyid kyi dus su phrad pa'i myu gu ni || ltung 'gyur a mra'i 'bras bu ci phyir 'byung || shes rab 'dus 185b7 pas gang gi khu ba 'dzag || 'di ni de yi bde ba gang gis 'phel ||17||
(cf. VP: kṣarati prajñāsaṅge yasya sitaṃ tasya kena sukhavṛddhiḥ | mukulaṃ vasantasaṅge patati phalaṃ kena cūtasya ||)
gang gis 'dzag pa med pa ma thob par || de 'dzag bde ba 'dod pa sdug bsngal yin || chu ni kun gyi 'tsho ba byed pa ni || tsa Ta ka skom sa ya chu mi 'thung ||18||
(cf. VP: yenākṣaraṃ na labdhaṃ sa kṣaraṃ saukhyaṃ samūhate duḥkhī | sarvo mṛgapa(ya)ti toyaṃ tṛṣito ’pi na vā(cā)tako bhūstham ||)
'khor ba bde ba mi rtag pa || ma 186a1 thob 'dod pa rmongs chen po || mkhas pa mthar phyin spangs byas la || yang dag rgyal ba'i bden ston to ||19||
(cf. VP: saṃsārasukham anityam aprāptam apīhate mahāmūrkhaḥ | sāmrājyasukhaṃ prāptaṃ(pto) vidvān saṃtyajati mokṣāya ||)
ri dwags rgyal po ri dwags zas za ba || lo gcig nang du gal te 'khrig par spyod || gseg ma phra mo zas su za ba yi || phug ron 186a2 rtag tu 'dod pa spyod pa yis ||20||
(cf. VP: varṣāvadheḥ kādacit surataratiṃ mṛgapa(ya)ti mṛgāhārī | pāṣāṇakaṇāhārī nityaṃ pārāvataḥ kurute ||)
gnyis ka la yang mchog gi bde ba med || res 'ga' rtag tu khu 'dzag gang ji bzhin || de bzhin 'dod ldan nang ni dka' thub pa || sad dang rmi lam na ni 'dzag pa'i phyir ||21||
(cf. VP: ubhayos tu na paramasukha (∸) sakṛt sadā śukrapātato yadvat | tadvat tapaści(sva) kāmukayoḥ svapnajāgratoḥ kṣaraṇāt ||)
ji ltar gnyid log sprul gyis sos btab pa || mi 'tsho khu ba bsdus pa 186a3 med pa ltar || de bzhin du ni so yis btab pa yi || dka' thub dang ni byis pa'i skyon rnams so ||22||
(cf. VP: supto ’pi sarpadaṣṭo na jīvati śukta(kra)saṃgrahābhāvāt | yadvat tadvad daṣṭastapaspatenāvalāyonyā (bhraṣṭas tapas patikhavalāyonyāḥ) ||)
ji ltar rdo sogs skud pa las byas gos || de nyid mer bsregs dag par 'gyur pa ltar || [de bzhin skyes bu rnams kyi dam pa yi || sems ni shes rab ye shes dag gis so] ||23||
(cf. VP: dagdhaṃ śikhinaiva śikāvalkalasūtraṃśukaṃ bhavati śuddham | yadvat tadvat puṃsāṃ prajñājñānena sac cittam ||)

ji ltar dngul chu me la bsregs na rab 186a4 tu 'brel te g.yo bar mi 'gyur ltar || de bzhin skye gnas dang ni reg pa khu ba rtag tu 'pho ba yin || ji ltar sman la sogs pa'i stobs kyis g.yo ba yang ni me dang phrad na de 'ching ltar || de bzhin shes rab yang dag phrad pas khu ba'i blo yis sbyangs pas so ||24|| (untraced, resembles LKCT 4.224) rgyud 'di dag gi rgya cher 186a5 'grel || de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa'i || 'jam dpal gyis ni bskul nas ni || 'jig rten mgon pos bris pa nyid ||25||
(cf. VP: asmin tantre mayā ṭīkā sugatavyākṛtena vai | mañjuśrī coditenaiva lokanāthena likhyate ||)
byis pa mkhas dang rmongs rnams la || rgyud kyi gsang ba gsal byed do || ma nyid bu rnams la phan pa || bde 'dod lus can thams cad 186a6 la ||26||
(cf. VP: bālapaṇḍitamūrkhāṇāṃ tantre guhyaprakāśikā | hitā māteva putrāṇāṃ sukhārtha sarvadehinām ||)
lam bzang rdo rje sems dpa' yi || bdag gis rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa || de phyir [dri ma med pa'i 'od || 'grel bshad] de ni myur du bri || 27||
(cf. VP: sanmārgaṃ vajrasattvasya yayā vindanti yoginaḥ | tasmāt sā likhyate kṣipraṃ ṭīkeyaṃ vimalaprabhā ||)
Prologue

｢'dir dang por re zhig rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas | brjod par bya ba dang | rjod par byed pa dang | 'brel ba dang | dgos pa dang | dgos pa'i yang 186a7 dgos pa mngon par gzigs nas | gdul bya'i skye bo nges pa dang bral ba rnams kyi rang gi sems kyi bsam pa de nyid kyi skye ba 'dir sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu ster ba | bde ba chen po la gnas pa'i dang po mchog gi sangs rgyas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po seng ge'i 186b1 gdan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo'i rgyal po dang | lha dang | klu dang | lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba | khams gsum gyis zhabs kyi padma la phyag 'tshal ba | lo ka gsum pas gcig tu 'khor los sgyur ba'i dang po mchog 186b2 gi sangs rgyas rgyu med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la zla ba bzang pos gsol ba btab pas | stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang | dang po mchog gi sangs rgyas rgyu med pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje 'chang | ye shes kyi sku'i dbang du gyur pa'i mtshan yang 186b3 dag par brjod pa dang ldan pa | rgyud rnams thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig gi dbang du gyur pa | rgyud gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs nas rtogs par bya'o || sangs rgyas kyi rin po che'i za ma tog kha bye ba | lo ka dang lo ka las 'das pa'i bden pa la brten pa mngon par byang 186b4 chub pa bzhi dang | rdo rje bzhi yongs su dag pa dang | sku bzhi dang | rigs drug dang | bden pa bcu gnyis dang | de kho na nyid bcu drug dang | stong pa nyid bcu drug dang | snying rje bcu drug gi bdag nyid dang | loka pa'i dbang bcu dang | loka las 'das pa'i dbang bcu 186b5 gcig pa gsal bar dbang bskur ba dang | dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang | las kyi phyag rgya dang | ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang | phyag rgya chen pos loka dang loka las 'das pa'i sgrub pa ni |｣ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i le'u bcu bzhir gnas pa ni brjod par bya'o || 'dir rjod 186b6 par byed pa ni le'u bcu bzhi'i tshig dang yi ge'i tshogs su gnas pa'o || ｢yang brjod par bya ba ni dang po sangs rgyas rgyu med pa'o || rjod par byed pa yang de skad brjod pa'o || yang na brjod par bya ba ni ye shes kyi sku | rjod par byed pa ni de'i tshig gi tshogs so || brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi 186b7 mtshan nyid kyi brjod bya rjod byed kyi 'brel pa'o || 'dir dang po dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang | lo ka pa'i dbang byin nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pa ni dgos pa'o || shes rab chen po bzhi pa lo ka las 'das pa'i dbang bskur nas rgyu med pa'i phyag rgya 187a1 chen po'i dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pa ni dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o || de dag gis ni de nyid brjod par bya ba'i mtshan nyid du yang dag par gzigs nas | gdul bya'i skye bo “nges pa dang 187a2 bral ba rnams kyi sems” zhes bya ba ni nges pa'i nyan thos kyi sdom pa la bya ste | 'dod pa'i longs spyod lnga la nges par longs spyod pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa zhes bya ste | de dang bral ba ni nges pa dang bral ba'o || de rnams kyi rang gi sems kyi bsam pa ni nges pa'i longs 187a3 spyod la nges par 'dod pa'o || de bzhin du dbang po gnyis kyi bde ba chen po 'dod pa'i rang gi sems kyi bsam pa ni nges pa dang bral ba zhes bya'o || rang gi sems kyi bsam pas “skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu ster bas” zhes bya ste | 'dir skye ba ni mi'i skya ba 'di nyid 187a4 la sangs rgyas ster ba rgyud kyi rgyal por ro || lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba lnga'i skye ba rnams kyis ni ma yin no || de ci'i phyir zhe na| las med pa'i sar skyes pa'i phyir ro || 'dir lha la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang mir skye ba thob nas sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu nges par 187a5 thob par 'gyur zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi nges pa'o || “bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis khams drug gi bdag nyid kyi skyes bu chen po'i gang zag gis shes bzhin du las ngan pa'i skye ba 'dir sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur pa ni ma yin” zhes bya ba ni de 187a6 bzhin gshegs pa'i nges pa'o || des na 'dir sngags kyi theg pa las bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa 'di lta ste | rigs ngan smyig ma mkhan la sogs || mtshams med lnga po byed pa dag || sngags kyi spyod pa rjes spyad pas || tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'gyur || 187a7 zhes gsungs pa ni bden te | gang sngon du byas pa'i mtshams med pa la sogs pa ma rungs pa'i las te | skye ba 'dir sngags kyi theg pa'i phyir phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba'i don gyis bcom pa nyid de| gzhan glo bur gyi mi dge ba la mi 'jug pa'i phyir rdo rje chos 187b1 'byung gi khang par bdud bzhi'i bgegs la sogs pa 'jug pa'i sgo rnams su | byams pa dang | snying rje dang | dga' ba dang | btang snyoms la sogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi sgo glegs bcug nas| der rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub pa'i phyir| phyag rgya chen 187b2 po dang lhan cig pa'i mtshams med pa byas pa yang |skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu rnyed par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'i nges pa'o || yang sngags kyi theg par zhugs pa tsam gyis ni mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa ma rungs pa'i las byas pa 187b3 yang skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu rnyed par zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa ma yin no || 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa gsum gyi don mi shes par gsungs pa | theg pa gsum ni bcom ldan 'das kyis thog mar dge ba bar du dge 187b4 ba tha mar dge bar gsungs so || sngags kyi theg par zhugs nas sdig pa mi byed pa ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu rnyed par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i nges pa'o ||｣ sngags pas sha mi bza' ba'o || za ba yod na gsod pa yod pas so || rin gyis nyos na yang 187b5 de'i don du gsod pa'i phyir na sha sngags pas bza' bar mi bya'o || rnal 'byor pa rnams sha ma bkag pa ni kha na ma tho ba med pa'i ba lang dang khyi la sogs pa rang gi las kyis shi ba rnams so || ｢go ku la sogs pa lnga dang rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa lnga rnams | yungs kar gyi 187b6 tshad tsam nyin re bzhin du dam tshig gi don du bsten par bya'o || rtag tu kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bud med dang chang ni bsgom pa ma rmongs pa'i chos su gsungs so || rtsa ba'i rgyud las bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa| 'di lta ste | lha nor 'dzin dang pha ma dang || yid 'dod 187b7 sgrub don 'tshong ba gang || sems can skyon med bsad pa gang || gdug pa sdig pa byed rnams kyis || kha na ma tho byas pa'i sha || nyos nas sha dang 'dod bcas las || ma blangs snod du lhung ba dang || kha na ma tho med nyid phyir || srog chags gcig cig gi ni sha || mang 188a1 po zos pa mchog yin te || srog chags du ma yi ni sha || mi gcig gis ni mi bza' ba'o || snying rje bskyed par bya ba'i phyir || rnal 'byor ldan pas bza' bar byed || rnam par mi rtog pa yi sems || kha na ma tho med gzhan med || rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la | de nas stong pa nyid las 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po gzung bar bya ba'i phyir 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed pa ni nam mkha' chos kyi 'byung gnas 200b5 gru gsum pa nam mkha' khyab par bsam par bya'o || rnam par shes pa nāda'i tshul du gnas pa las yaṁ nag po cig 'og tu chad pas de gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla ba phyed pa lta bu rgya chen po la steng dang 'og tu rdo rje gnyis dang | mtha'i rtse mo la rlung gi ba dan gyis mtshan pa'o || 200b6 de'i steng du raṁ dmar po cig chad pas de gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rgya chen po cig bsam ste | steng 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang | mtha' ma'i zur gsum la g.yung drung ris dmar pos mtshon pa'o || de'i steng du baṁ dkar po cig chad pas de gyur pa 200b7 las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rgya chen cig bsam | steng dang 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang mtha' mar padma dkar po 'dab ma lngas mtshan pa'o || de'i steng du laṁ ser po cig chad pas de gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po rgya che ba la steng dang 'og tu sna tshogs 201a1 rdo rje gnyis dang zur bzhi la rdo rje rtse mo lnga pas mtshan pa'o || de'i steng du maṁ sna tshogs pa'i mdog can cig chad pa de gyur pa las dbus kyi ri rab shar nag po || lho dmar po | nub ser po || byang dkar po | dbus mthing ga zlum po dpangs su dpag tshad 201a2 'bum phrag gcig pa || 'og gi rgyal dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug pa | steng gi rgya la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa | steng gi phyogs bzhi na lcog bzhis mtshan pa'o || de'i steng du kṣa yig chad pas de gyur pa las sna tshogs padma dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa gcig bsam par 201a3 bya'o || de'i steng du haṁ dkar po la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang bcu gsum pa cig bsam mo || de'i steng du tsheg drag dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang rgya mnyam pa'o || de'i steng du thig le sngon po las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor 201a4 sngon po nyi zla dang rgya mnyam pa'o || de las
aṁ haṁ yaṁ raṁ baṁ laṁ vajra ākāśa bāyu teja udaka prithivī vajra svabhāva pañcadhātvo vajra maṇḍalani kuru kuru svāhā |

zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o || de'i steng du hūṁ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur dang sa gzhir gyur par bsam mo || de'i steng 201a5 du bhrūṁ mam yang na oṁ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa sgo gnyis brtsegs pa | rta babs dang snam bu dang dra ba phyed pa dang || dril bu dang | rnga yab dang | rgyal mtshan dang | ri dwags kyis mtshan pa | gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol rdo rje ra ba'i nang du dur khrod201a6 brgyad dang bcas pa rin po che'i rtsig pa lngas phyi rim dkyil 'khor la yod pa nang pho brang dkyil 'khor gru bzhi la le tshe dgu pa ka ba bcu drug rgyan dang ldan pa sum cha la gtso bo'i gdan ni paṁ las gyur pa'i gdan 'dab ma brgyad pa || de'i steng du zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi gdan dang 201a7 bcas par bsam par bya'o || Yab yum 5.2 (29) de nas yab yum bskyed pa ni || 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das || rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung || a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog || don chen yi ge dam pa yin ||29|| zhes pa phung po lnga dang khams lnga dang lnga lnga cha mnyam pa'i drug pa 201b1 yang yab yum bskyed pa gdan thog tu mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi sa bon du āli bcu drug nyis skor las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so || dpe byad bzang po'i sa bon du kāli so bzhi nyis skor las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so || 201b2 de nyid kyi bar du hūṁ sngon po cig bsam pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so || hūṁ de 'phros 'dus pa las rdo rje hūṁ gis mtshan pa'o || de las 'phros 'dus pa las haṁ sngon po cig tu gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so || de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa gcig tu gyur pa las yab yum gyi skur 201b3 rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las mngon par byang chub pa'o || de yang gdan padma dang nyi ma dang zla ba dang dus me'i steng na drag po dang 'dod pa'i lha mnan pa | dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa zhal dbus sngo ba g.yas dmar ba 201b4 g.yon dkar po || phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje | bar pa gri gug | tha ma dgra stva | g.yon na dril bu dang || thod pa dang | tshangs pa'i mgo bo'o || dbu la ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng na mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa | g.yon gyi phyogs na zla ba phyed pa can no | dbu la thod 201b5 pa lngas brgyan pa | thod pa rlon pa'i phreng bas se ral khar brgyan pa | stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o || yum chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog dang phyag mtshan yab dang mthun pas yab la 'khyud nas zhabs g.yon 201b6 brkyang ba'o || yab kyi thugs ka na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la arapacana zhes bya ba ye shes lnga bsdus pa'i ngo bo sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o || thugs ka na 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la arapacanaya te namaḥ gnas pa'o || 201b7 de'i lte ba la a sngon po'o || yab kyi sku la 'khor lo drug gi lte ba la haṁ oṁ āḥ hūṁ ho kṣa || ljang gu dang | dkar po dang | dmar po dang | nag po dang | ser po dang || sngon po rnams rim gyis gnas pa'o || a las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad bsdus nas yab 202a1 kyi zhal du zhugs nas rtsa dbus ma nas yum gyi padmar zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba de ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a la thim par bsam mo || a las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas yab kyi zhal dang dbu ma 202a2 dang yum gyi padmar zhu ba de ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a la thim par bsam mo || 5.3–5 (30–32) de nas 'khor bskyed pa ni skye ba'i rim pas dbyung bar bya ste | rnam shes phung po dag pa mi bskyod pa ni | mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che || nyon mongs kun gyi dgra che ba ||31cd|| zhes pa ye shes 202a3 sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a las a cig rna ba g.yas nas 'thon nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la mi bskyod pa sku mdog dang zhal phyag la sogs pa gtso bo dang mthun pa cig tu gyur nas dbu'i steng gi mi bskyod pa la thim mo || de nas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi le tshe bzhi la yab kyi 202a4 gdan padma dang nyi ma'i steng du spros pa las 'du byed kyi phung po dag pa don yod grub pa ni | mchod pa chen po khro ba che || khro ba chen po dgra che ba ||31cd|| zhes pa ni a las a cig sna g.yas pa las 'thon nas shar gyi le tshe'i gdan thog tu don yod grub par gyur nas zhal gsum la phyag 202a5 drug pa sku dang rtsa ba'i zhal nag po g.yas dmar ba g.yon dkar ba | phyag g.yas na ral gri dang | gri gug dang | rtse gsum pa g.yon phub dang thod pa dang khaṭvāṅga bsnams pa'o || tshor ba'i phung po dag pa rin 'byung ni | mchod pa chen po chags pa che || chags pa thams cad 202a6 sel bar byed ||32ab|| ces pas a las raṁ cig mig g.yas nas 'thon nas lho'i gdan thog tu rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum phyag drug pa | sku dang rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po || g.yas dkar po | g.yon nag po | g.yas na mda' dang lcags kyu dang || cang te'u dang g.yon 202a7 na gzhu dang | zhags pa dang | nor bu dri ma med pa'o || rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o || 'du shes kyi phung po dag pa snang ba mtha' yas ni | mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che || sems can thams cad dga' bar byed ||30ab|| ces pa a las u cig lce zur g.yas nas 'thon nas byang 202b1 gi le tshe'i gdan thog tu snang ba mtha' yas su gyur nas zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa sku dang rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yas nag po g.yon dmar po || phyag g.yas na tho ba dang mdung dang | rtse gsum pa | g.yon na padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang | me long dang | bgrang phreng ngo || rdo rje 202b2 skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o || gzugs kyi phung po dag pa rnam par snang mdzad ni | mchod pa chen po gti mug che || gti mug blo te gti mug sel ||31ab|| zhes pa a las li cig bshang lam g.yas zur nas 'thon nas nub kyi le tshe'i gdan thog tu rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum 202b3 pa phyag drug pa | sku dang rtsa zhal ser po g.yas dkar po g.yon nag po || g.yas na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa dang rdo rje | g.yon na mdung dang | lcags kyu dang | dril bu'o || rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o || Vajradhātvīśvarī, Tārā, Pāṇḍaravāsinī, Māmakī and Buddhalocanā nam mkha'i khams dag pa rdo rje dbyings phyug ma ni | a ni yig 'bru kun 202b4 gyi mchog ||28a|| ces pa yang a las a cig rna ba g.yon nas 'thon nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje dbang phyug ma mi bskyod pa dang 'dra ba cig tu gyur nas de nas rtsa ba'i yum la thim mo || mtshams bzhi'i le tshe'i steng du gdan padma dang zla ba'i steng du yum rnams padma'i bzhugs 202b5 stangs kyis gnas te | rlung gi khams dag pa sgrol ma ni || tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed ||29d|| ces pa a las i sna g.yon pa nas me'i mtshams kyi gdan thog tu sgrol mar gyur nas sku mdog la sogs pa ni don yod grub pa bzhin no || me'i khams dag pa gos dkar mo ni | 202b6 tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste ||29b|| zhes pa a las ri cig mig g.yon pa nas 'thon nas bden bral du gos dkar mor gyur te rin 'byung bzhin no || chu'i khams dag pa māmakī la a las u cig lce zur g.yon nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams su māmakīr gyur nas snang ba mtha' 202b7 yas bzhin no || sa'i khams dag pa sangs rgyas spyan [ma] ni | srog chen po ni skye ba med ||29a|| ces pa a las li cig bshang lam nas 'thon nas rlung gi mtshams su sangs rgyas spyan du gyur nas rnam par snang mdzad bzhin du | yum rnams padma'i bzhugs stangs kyis 203a1 gnas pa'o || de rnams phung po drug dang khams drug bsdus pas lha'i dbus kyi pho brang ni ye shes kyi 'khor lo'o || 5.8 (35) de'i phyi rol lha rnams kyi thugs kyi 'khor lo la | sems dpa' bcu drug spros te | yang a las a bzhi sna'i sgo nas shar gyi snam bu la rim 203a2 pas sems dpa' bzhir gyur te | mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang ||35a|| zhes pa dang po snying ga'i 'khor lo dag pa rlung gi khams rdo rje las so || sgyu 'phrul chen po don grub pa ||35b|| zhes pa de'i 'og sna'i dbang po dag po rdo rje las so || rlung gi khams dag pa rdo rje srung ba'o || 203a3 sgyu 'phrul chen po dga' bas dga' ||35c|| zhes pa de'i 'og reg bya dag pa rlung gi khams gnod sbyin no || sgyu 'phrul chen po mig 'phrul can ||35d|| zhes pa tha mal yul sgra nam mkha'i khams dag pa rdo rje khu tshur ro || de bzhin du sku mdog la sogs pa don yod grub pa bzhin no || 5.6 (33) yang a 203a4 las a bzhi mig nas 'thon nas lho phyogs kyi gdan thog tu sems dpa' bzhir gyur te || gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste ||33a|| zhes pa ste dang po mgrin pa me'i 'khor lo dag pa me'i khams sems dpa' rdo rje rin chen no || kha dog che zhing lus bong che ||33b|| zhes pa de'i 'og mig gi dbang po 203a5 dag pa me'i khams rdo rje nyi ma'o || ming yang che zhing rgya che ba ||33c|| zhes pa de'i 'og ro'i khams dag pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan no || dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin ||33d|| zhes pa tha ma yid nam mkha'i khams dag pa rdo rje bzhad pa'o || de bzhin rin chen 'byung ldan bzhin no || 5.7 (34) yang a las 203a6 u cig lce las 'thon nas byang phyogs kyi gdan thog tu gyur spros pas sems dpa' bzhir gyur te | shes rab mtshon chen 'chang ba ste ||34a|| zhes pa dang po dpral ba chu'i 'khor lo dag pa rdo rje chos so || nyon mongs chen po lcags kyu'i mchog ||34b|| ces pa de'i 'og yul gzugs dag pa 203a7 chu'i khams rdo rje rnon po'o || grags chen snyan grags chen po ste ||34c|| zhes pa de'i 'og lce'i dbang po dag pa chu'i khams rdo rje rgyu'o || snang ba chen po gsal ba che ||34d|| zhes pa tha ma khu ba chos dag pa nam mkha'i khams rdo rje smra ba'o || de bzhin snang ba mtha' yas bzhin no || 5.5 (32) yang a las 203b1 āli bzhi bshang ba'i sgo nas 'thon pa nub phyogs kyi gdan thog tu sems dpa' bzhir gyur te | 'dod pa chen po[32c] zhes pa dang po lte ba'i sa'i 'khor lo dag pa rdo rje sems dpa'o || bde ba chen po[32c] zhes pa de'i 'og lus kyi dbang po dag pa sa'i khams rdo rje rgyal po | dga' ba chen po[32d] zhes pa 203b2 de'i 'og tu yul dri sa'i khams dag pa rdo rje legs pa'o || mgu ba chen po[32d] zhes pa tha ma rna ba'o || dbang po dag pa ye shes kyi khams rdo rje chags pa'o || de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad bzhin no || sems dpa' thams cad gdan padma dang nyi ma'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs 203b3 pa'o || de thugs kyi 'khor lo'o || 5.9 (36) de'i sgo g.yas g.yon gyi 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad spros te | brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin ||36d|| zhes pa yang a las sna g.yon nas ni gcig 'phros pas shar gyi sgo'i g.yas kyi gdan thog tu pags pa rlung gi khams 203b4 dag pa gar ma sngon mo gar bsgyur ba'o || [36b] tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog || ces pa a las mA cig mig g.yon nas 'thon nas lho'i sgo'i g.yas su 'phros pa las khrag me'i khams dag pa mā le dmar mo phreng ba 'dzin pa'o || bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po ||36c|| zhes pa 203b5 a las gī cig lce zur g.yon nas 'thon nas byang sgo'i g.yas su 'phros pas rngul chu'i khams dag pa gīti dkar mo pi wang gis glu len pa'o || 5.11a (38a) byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med ||38a|| ces pa a las a cig bshang lam g.yon zur nas nub sgo'i g.yas su spros pas rus pa 203b6 sa'i khams dag palāsye ser mo 'gying ba'i tshul byed pa'o || 5.10 (37) smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste ||37d|| zhes pa a las gcig sna sgo g.yon nas 'thon nas sgo g.yon du 'phros pas sha rlung gi khams dag pa dri chab ma nag mo dri thogs pa'o || shes rab chen po lus 'chang ba ||37b|| 203b7 zhes pa a las mig g.yon nas du cig 'thon nas lho sgo'i g.yon du 'phros pas chu ser me'i khams dag pa'i me tog ma dmar mo me tog thogs pa'o || stobs po che la thabs che ba ||37c|| zhes pa a las lce zur g.yon nas a cig 'thon nas byang sgo'i g.yon du 'phros pas | gci 204a1 ba chu'i khams dag pa mar me ma mar me thogs pa'o || bsam gtan chen po ting 'dzin gnas ||37a|| zhes pa a las bshang lam gyi g.yon du dhu cig 'phros| nub sgo'i g.yon du spros pas rkang pa dag pa sa'i khams bdug spos ma ser mo thogs pa'o || lha mo 204a2 brgyad po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhi ba'i tshul du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o || de ni gsung gi 'khor lo'o || || 5.12 (39) de nas sku'i 'khor lo la khro bo bcu spros te | rdzu 'phrul chen po'i stobs dang ldan ||39a|| zhes pa a las ya cig sna g.yon pa nas 'thon nas shar gyi 204a3 rtsibs la spros pas ngag gi dbang po rlung gi khams dag pa bgegs mthar byed nag po'o || shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ste ||39b|| zhes pa a las mig g.yon pa nas ra cig 'thon nas | lho'i rtsibs la spros pas lag pa'i dbang po me'i khams dag pa shes rab mthar byed do || rdzu 'phrul 204a4 chen po cher grags pa ||39c|| zhes pa a las lce'i zur g.yon nas wa cig 'thon nas | byang phyogs kyi rtsibs la spros pas rkang pa'i dbang po chu'i khams dag pa khro bo padma mthar byed pa'o || stobs chen pha rol gnon pa ste ||39d|| zhes pa a las bshang ba'i lam nas la cig 'thon 204a5 nas nub kyi rtsibs la spros pas bshang ba'i dbang po sa'i khams dag pa khro bo gshin rje mthar byed pa'o || 5.13 (40) srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms ||40a|| zhes pa a las mig g.yas pa nas a cig 'thon nas | me'i rtsibs la spros pas 'dus pa rlung gi khams dag pa dbyug sngon can no || 204a6 mkhregs shing rdo rje chen po 'chang ||40b|| zhes pa mig g.yas pa nas ra cig 'thon nas | bden bral gyi rtsibs la spros pas me'i khams dag pa khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o || drag po chen po drag shul che ||40c|| zhes pa a las chu'i lam nas wa cig spros pas | dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la 204a7 rngul chu'i khams dag pa khro bo mi g.yo ba'o || 'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa po ||40d|| zhes pa a las gtsug tor nas la cig 'thon nas | rlung gi rtsibs la spros pas bad kan sa'i khams dag pa khro bo stobs po che'o || shar dang me'i khro bo'i zhal phyag ni don grub bzhin no || lho 204b1 dang bden bral ni rin 'byung bzhin no || byang dang dbang ldan ni snang mtha' bzhin no || nub dang rlung mtshams ni rnam snang bzhin no || 5.14 (41) mgon po rigs mchog chen po ste ||41a|| zhes pa rna ba g.yon pa nas ha cig 'thon nas | steng gi rtsibs la dbang po mchog ye shes dag pa khro bo gtsug tor 'khor los 204b2 sgyur pa sku mdog gtso bo dang mthun pa'o || bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog ||40b|| ces pa a las rna ba g.yas pa nas ha cig 'thon nas 'og gi rtsibs la gci ba'i dbang po nam mkha'i khams dag pa khro bo gnod mdzes so || zhal phyag la sogs mi bskyod dang mthun pa'o || khro bo rnams 204b3 nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o || de ni sku'i 'khor lo'o || lha bzhi bcu gsum gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'o || zhe lnga'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni | theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas ||40c|| zhes pa ye shes 'khor lo'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa'o || theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog ||40d|| 204b4 ces pa ye shes 'khor lo'i 'og tu rdo rje dbang phyug ma gdan padma dang zla ba la gnas pa ste zhe lnga'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'o || 5.11 (38) zhe dgu pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni de'i steng du | byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med ||38a|| ces pas a las sna nas hoḥ cig shar sgor 'phros pas sgo ba dril bu'o || snying rje 204b5 chen po blo yi mchog ||38b|| ces pa a las mig nas hūṃ cig 'phros pas | nang gi lho'i sgor sgo ba zhags pa'o || shes rab chen po blo chen ldan ||38c|| zhes pa a las lce las baṃ cig 'thon nas | byang gi nang sgor 'phros pas sgo ba lcags sgrog ma'o || mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba ||38d|| 204b6 zhes pa a las bshang lam nas jaḥ cig 'thon nas | nub kyi nang sgor 'phros pas sgo ba lcags kyu'o || sku mdog gi rigs gong ma bzhin du bsams pas zhe dgu pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'o || The supreme actions of a king da ni las rgyal mchog brjod par bya ste | ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang ba ni || ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a 204b7 las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la lha mo brgyad kyis bstod pa bya | 'dud kyis bstod la de nas khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyis jaḥ zhes brjod pas dgug | khro bo shes rab mthar byed kyis hūṃ 205a1 zhes brjod pas gzhug | khro bo gshin rje mthar byed kyis baṃ zhes brjod pas bcings | khro bo padma mthar byed kyis hoḥ zhes brjod pas dgyes par bya'o || des dam tshig pa ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin du byas so || de nas spyi gtsug dang dpral ba dang mgrin 205a2 pa dang snying ga dang lte ba dang gsang ba rnams su | haṃ oṃ āḥ hūṃ hoḥ kṣa kha dog so sor 'od zer 'phros 'dus pa las rigs drug gi de bzhin gshegs pa drug tu gyur pas gtso bo la byin gyis brlabs | 'khor rnams la sku gsung thugs las oṃ āḥ hūṃ las rigs gsum du gyur pas 205a3 byin gyis brlab bo || de nas dbang bskur ba ni thugs ka'i a las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha'i tshogs spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la | mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod nas | bdag la dbang bskur cig par gsol ba btab pas | rigs lnga'i de bzhin 205a4 gshegs pa yab yum gyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas blugs pas lus kyi sgrib pa rnams dag nas | chu thigs pa re re spyi bor gsal ba las| gtso bo yab yum
